# Code Anchors: Checkout-Only Path Gate

- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-master-reads.ts` — the scanner and its classifier: the guarded location, the contrast markers, the sentence-bounded and distance-capped window, the per-line mention record, and the reads-only filter the gate fails on.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-master-reads.spec.ts` — the gate itself, run over the live authored payload, plus unit coverage for the exemption, a fallback, a plain read, an earlier-sentence negation, and the body/line reporting.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/seed-templates.ts` — supplies the guarded location, so the gate and the seed cannot disagree about which directory is the checkout-only one.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/vendor-components.ts` — enumerates the shipped bodies the scan walks.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the body whose fallback this gate replaced.
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the body that names the guarded location only to rule it out, and so must stay exempt.
